title: Amazon Cracks Down On Use of AI Images By Sellers - Slashdot

content_html:
CNBC reports: Amazon is requiring that third-party sellers label any product images or videos that contain "AI-generated people" after New York recently passed a law mandating greater transparency around "synthetic performers" in ads... The policy directs sellers to tag images [and videos or other graphics on listing pages] with specific metadata keywords before they're uploaded. "Recent legislation requires disclosure when images or videos in advertisements contain photorealistic AI-generated people," Amazon wrote in the announcement [clarifying that the requirement doesn't apply to content featuring TV/video game/movie characters or content including real people, even if they've been altered using AI]. The company said it will "add an indicator" to listings on its website, informing consumers that images or other content feature AI-generated people, "where applicable." It's unclear what criteria Amazon will apply when deciding when to display the label to shoppers...

Amazon has embraced AI internally and it's increasingly infusing the technology across its portfolio. The company has optimized listing titles and details so they're more likely to be spotted by AI systems, invested in a recently rebranded assistant called Alexa for Shopping, and launched a feature that injects AI-generated [images of] products into its search bar in real time based on user queries. More Amazon third-party sellers are using AI to generate text, images and other content for their listings, partly by using the company's tools.


Outside sellers account for more than 60% of goods sold on Amazon, the article points out. It adds that there's currently no nationwide U.S. law requiring companies to disclose AI-generated advertising content, it adds — but YouTube, Meta, Pinterest, and TikTok have already added labels for AI-generated content.

And a new California law also requires large AI providers to embed watermarks in AI-generated images, video and other content...

content_html_zh:
CNBC 报道：在纽约最近通过一项法律，要求提高广告中“合成表演者”的透明度后，亚马逊要求第三方卖家在任何包含“人工智能生成的人”的产品图片或视频上贴上标签…… 该政策指示卖家在上传图像[以及列表页面上的视频或其他图形]之前使用特定的元数据关键字对其进行标记。 亚马逊在公告中写道：“最近的立法要求广告中的图像或视频包含真实的人工智能生成的人物时进行披露”（澄清该要求不适用于以电视/视频游戏/电影角色为特色的内容或包含真人的内容，即使它们已使用人工智能进行了更改）。 该公司表示，将在其网站上的列表中“添加一个指示器”，告知消费者“在适用的情况下”，图像或其他内容包含人工智能生成的人物。 目前尚不清楚亚马逊在决定何时向购物者展示标签时将应用什么标准...... 亚马逊已在内部拥抱人工智能，并越来越多地将这项技术融入其产品组合中。 该公司优化了列表标题和详细信息，以便它们更有可能被人工智能系统发现，投资了最近更名为 Alexa for Shopping 的助手，并推出了一项功能，可以根据用户查询将人工智能生成的产品[图像]实时注入其搜索栏中。 越来越多的亚马逊第三方卖家正在使用人工智能为其商品生成文本、图像和其他内容，部分是通过使用该公司的工具。 文章指出，外部卖家占亚马逊销售商品的 60% 以上。 它还补充说，目前美国没有全国性法律要求公司披露人工智能生成的广告内容，但 YouTube、Meta、Pinterest 和 TikTok 已经为人工智能生成的内容添加了标签。

而加州的一项新法律还要求大型人工智能提供商在人工智能生成的图像、视频和其他内容中嵌入水印……
